content.text:
**Cloudflare Workers has experienced multiple outages and incidents over the past year**, primarily minor in scope. These often involve elevated errors, API latency, degraded AI model availability, or location-specific issues rather than full global outages. Major incidents (e.g., in 2025) were tied to dependencies like Workers KV storage.[[1]](https://isdown.app/status/cloudflare-workers/outage-history)

### Recent and Notable Incidents (as of September 2026)
- **September 2, 2026 (Narita location-specific)**: Increased errors for customers running Workers scripts in Narita. Started ~1:02 AM UTC, identified and fixed by ~2:10–2:24 AM UTC (minor impact, resolved quickly).[[2]](https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/incidents/lmsfz6pcb65c)
- **July 17, 2026 (Workers API)**: Issues interacting with the Workers API and dashboard configuration (e.g., errors when deploying scripts). Production Workers were unaffected. Incident lasted ~21 minutes.[[3]](https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/incidents/km4651q3bfdf)
- **June 25–26, 2026 (Workers AI)**: Errors with inference requests to the `@cf/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it` model. Resolved within ~2–3 hours after a fix was implemented.[[4]](https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/incidents/bpz4p8wxt2lw)
- **April 2026 (multiple minor incidents)**: Included elevated 502 errors (28 minutes), API latency (~2 hours, affecting builds/webhooks), and a longer ~19-hour KV API latency/timeouts issue impacting Assets.[[1]](https://isdown.app/status/cloudflare-workers/outage-history)

### Major Historical Outages (2025)
- **November 18, 2025 (global)**: Triggered by a database permissions change that corrupted a Bot Management "feature file," causing widespread HTTP 5xx errors, failures in Turnstile, Workers KV, and related services. Not a cyber attack. Cloudflare later implemented "Code Orange: Fail Small" resiliency changes (e.g., segmented rollouts starting with free customers, faster detection/rollback) to prevent similar broad impacts.[[5]](https://blog.cloudflare.com/18-november-2025-outage/)[[6]](https://blog.cloudflare.com/code-orange-fail-small-complete/)
- **June 12, 2025 (global, ~2.5 hours)**: Severe outage affecting Workers KV (90%+ failure on uncached reads/writes), WARP, Access, Gateway, Images, Stream, Workers AI, and more. Root cause was a third-party cloud provider outage impacting KV's underlying storage. Cloudflare accelerated migration to its own R2 storage for better resilience; no data loss or security breach.[[7]](https://blog.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-service-outage-june-12-2025/)[[8]](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/cloudflare-outage-not-caused-by-security-incident-data-is-safe/)

### Patterns and Current Status
Cloudflare's official status page and post-mortems show most recent issues are short-lived and isolated (e.g., specific models, APIs, or POPs like Narita). Production-running Workers are frequently unaffected, with impacts focused on deployments, AI inference, or KV. The company has emphasized architectural improvements like cohort-based deployments and reduced third-party dependencies following the 2025 incidents.[[6]](https://blog.cloudflare.com/code-orange-fail-small-complete/)

For real-time updates, check:
- [Cloudflare Status](https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/)
- Incident trackers like [IsDown for Cloudflare Workers](https://isdown.app/status/cloudflare-workers/outage-history) (which has logged 66+ incidents since September 2025).[[1]](https://isdown.app/status/cloudflare-workers/outage-history)

If you're experiencing a current issue, provide more details (e.g., error messages, locations, or timestamps) for further help.
